The type is not the first key, which no prefix match would have caught [5].

```json
{"nodes":[{"id":"a","label":"Read config","kind":"start","src":[5]},{"id":"b","label":"Start pipeline","kind":"end","src":[8]}],"edges":[{"from":"a","to":"b","label":"Ready"}],"type":"flow"}
```

The pipeline then runs [8].
